extracted.summary: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Shiksha Protsahan) Yojana provides free higher education support to eligible students whose parent is registered as an unorganised worker in Madhya Pradesh.
extracted.amount_text: For Engineering in a private college the cover is INR 1.5 lakh or the actual payable fee, whichever is lower.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Undergraduate, postgraduate, polytechnic diploma and ITI courses are covered.
extracted.states_quote: The parent must be registered as an unorganised worker with the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
